title: portfolio-research.v1 request envelope
description: Request envelope for POST /api/portfolio-research. Producer: Research specialist. Consumer: Position Lens. Carries only symbols, deterministic reason codes, optional opaque review-item IDs, and timestamps -- no personal balances, liabilities, goals, policies, account identifiers, holdings quantities/values, cost basis, or other brokerage/personal data. Maximum serialized request body is 16 KiB; this limit cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and MUST be enforced by the transport layer independently of this schema. Unknown top-level fields are rejected (additionalProperties: false) -- this is the privacy boundary, not just a convention.

contractVersion.description: Must be the exact literal 'portfolio-research.v1'. Any other value (including other portfolio-research.vN strings) must be rejected explicitly, never best-effort parsed as v1.

requestId.description: Opaque idempotency/correlation identifier. Must not encode identity or account data.

reasonCodes.description: Closed enum of deterministic triggers for why public research was requested. Must never disclose threshold values, holding size, loss amount, risk tolerance, or personal goals.

items.description: Opaque Position Lens-local reference. Must not encode account or holding data.
